exposure: Women with a previous full dilation cesarean section
cohort: Women attending the Preterm Surveillance Clinic at St Thomas' Hospital, London, with a history of emergency cesarean section followed by spontaneous preterm birth or late miscarriage
finding: Transvaginal cervical cerclage was less effective in preventing preterm birth among pregnant women who have had an emergency cesarean section followed by spontaneous preterm birth or late miscarriage compared with other high-risk women.
mod_finding: The lack of efficacy of transvaginal cervical cerclage in preventing preterm birth in the subgroup with a previous full dilation cesarean section was similar to that observed in women with an emergency cesarean section at less than full dilation.
